items.reason: Chose to enforce uniqueness (YAML 1.2.2 §3.2.1.1) in YAML.Representation.Graph.init: a mapping whose key is the same node as, or a node equal to (same tag, equal content; sequences elementwise, mappings as unordered entry sets; cycles handled by co-inductive assumption), an earlier key throws the new Error.duplicateKey(identifier of the later key). Scalars compare by text, not schema-canonical form (documented in README). Tests: same node twice, equal scalars, equal sequences, same text with different tags is allowed.

api_changes: New case YAML.Representation.Graph.Error.duplicateKey(YAML.Representation.Node.Identifier) on a @frozen public enum
Behaviour: Graph.init / Builder.finalize throw for duplicate mapping keys
